scenarios.title: Update every editable task detail
evidence: Opened the seeded task editor and changed title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
Observed one updated task with its original completion state and no old title.
No browser console or page errors were observed.

scenarios.title: Cancel changes and reject a blank title
evidence: Canceled a changed title and observed the original task unchanged with no duplicate.
Attempted to save a whitespace-only title and observed the required-title alert and invalid field.
No browser console or page errors were observed.

scenarios.title: Persist a committed edit across reload
evidence: Saved a new task title, reloaded the page, and observed the edited title exactly once.
Observed that the original title did not return after reload.
No browser console or page errors were observed.

scenarios.title: Edit a task with accessible keyboard controls
evidence: Focused the task-specific Edit control and activated it with Enter.
Observed focus move to the labeled title field, then focused Save changes and activated it with Enter.
Observed the saved title in the task list without relying on hover or color.
No browser console or page errors were observed.

scenarios.title: Preserve filtering, persistence, and existing task actions
evidence: Vitest passed coverage for edited-value search, completion, deletion, task creation, filtering, summaries, and local-storage persistence.
